bridges.description: Support the existence of the classical-theist God identified as necessary unlimited being with intellect, will, and perfect goodness.
Infer from contingent reality and the principle of sufficient reason to a necessary ground of existence.
Infer from a finite temporal universe to an immaterial, timeless, powerful, and personal cause.
Treat life-permitting order and fine-tuned constants as evidence of purposive design.
Infer from objective moral facts, equal dignity, and intrinsic prohibitions to perfect goodness as their ground.
Withhold the classical-theist conclusion unless its premises and its advantage over naturalistic and supernaturalistic alternatives are established.
Challenge the warrant for contingency, temporal-beginning, fine-tuning, and moral premises without adopting a burden to prove that no conceivable god exists.
Require probability-sensitive comparison of theism with the full range of relevant alternatives rather than a move from possibility or generic supernaturalism.
Treat nonresistant nonbelief and gratuitous suffering as probabilistic evidence favoring naturalism or different God concepts over classical theism.
Keep polytheism, deism, quasi-deism, pantheism, pandeism, and other monotheisms live as distinct rival explanations.
